reviews.Author: Diana Jordan
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on September 1, 2015
reviews.Text: I recently got a collection of finishing salts but purchased a large bag of this one. It was one of the salts in the collection. This salt is excellent as a finishing salt, but it also is really great for absorbing flavors. Put some in a jar with fresh herbs (I use rosemary stems). I had made my own hazelnut bourbon smoked salt with a different type earlier in the year and now I can't wait until that stash is gone so I can smoke a batch of this. Based on how well it has absorbed herbs it will probably take on smoke really well, and in a lot less time than the previous.

reviews.Author: Shala Kerrigan
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on June 4, 2012
reviews.Text: I have a small collection of finishing salts that I use for different things. This one is my favorite for things like salad and desserts. It's gorgeous with large crystal shapes that are very thin, some are just flakes, but other pieces are like shallow hollow pyramids. The flavor is mild and they have a nice snap which adds a textural interest to chocolates and candies. For more robust flavors, I prefer stronger flavored salts like smoked or Peruvian pink salts.
